name: Autódromo Internacional do Algarve
layout: Grand Prix circuit, clockwise (4.653 km, 15 turns) as used by GT4 European Series 2026 (GTWC Endurance finale)

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap raceway ways (corner ways tagged ref 1-15), graph-routed; the "access=permissive" shortcut variants at T6, T7/8, T13, T15 and the kart track excluded; start/finish = OSM node 5006070798 raceway=finish (timing line; the separate raceway=start node 5006082198 is the grid start).
sources.width: OSM width=14 tags on the circuit ways (https://www.openstreetmap.org); main straight (untagged) 15 m nominal. DGT Ortos2021 WMS (cartografia.dgterritorio.gov.pt) returned blank tiles, so no aerial measurement.
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (tile Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N37_00_W009_00_DEM, https://copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com/); no open national LiDAR service for the Algarve found.
sources.pit: OSM raceway way 157790380 "Pit Lane" (maxspeed 80 tag is the MotoGP/F1 value), entry after Sagres before Galp, exit at the end of the main straight before T1
sources.trim: Mix of a ~970 m straight and blind medium-speed corners: around Spa level
sources.pitLimit: GT4: 50 km/h, SRO GT4 European Series 2026 pit-lane limit (stewards notices citing art. 34.11, e.g. https://www.gt4europeanseries.com/documents/notice/3047/, DEF GT4 BRIEFING SPA 2026)
sources.layout: GT4 2026 Portimão results PDF: "Portimao, Length: 4653m, turn count 15" (https://www.gt4europeanseries.com/results/2026/portimao)

notes: OSM centreline is +0.6% long vs 4,653 m (Galp curve way 363133195 chosen over the straighter permissive variant, which looked like a shortcut). Turn numbers from OSM ref tags. TCR Europe does not race here in 2026; GT4 pitLoss unknown.
